description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git functionalities, specifically focused on diff and merge operations, including combined diffs, handling of multiple merge parents, space-coalescing, and filename sorting. It contains setup routines, test cases, and expected outcomes to verify Git's diff tools and merge behaviors.

methods.name: setup_helper
methods.description: Sets up branches and commits for testing merge scenarios by creating files with different content and performing git operations.

methods.name: verify_helper
methods.description: Verifies diff outputs by extracting relevant lines and comparing them with expected diff results.
